verdict.rationale: Box documents a broad REST API covering most core UI actions: chunked uploads, shared links, collaborations/permissions, search, metadata, webhooks, event streams, Box AI, and Box Sign. Box Sign is the only area explicitly claimed to bring 'the full web app experience' through the API. Box also offers AI-agent surfaces through its CLI and hosted MCP server. However, no evidence asserts general API/UI parity, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, so full coverage cannot be verified. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement, evidence for admin-console and settings operations via API, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
